evals.name: partner-business-review-eval-1
evals.expected_output: Results are Covered (goal of four deals, two closed). Pipeline is Partial (a manufacturer with a demo, not sure they will buy). Registration is Partial because Pat said "I think so". Blockers are Partial because the docs issue has no date. Support needs are Partial. The next-period goal is Covered (six deals) or Partial. The next review is Partial because "three months" has no date.
expectations: Every one of the 7 dimensions gets a Status
Every finding cites a quote or timestamp from the transcript, or is marked Unclear rather than guessed
A claim that only the rep makes is not counted as evidence
A dimension the call never touched is scored Missed
Ends with exactly one closing line and no recap of all scores
Registration is Partial because the partner said "I think so"
The blocker (out-of-date onboarding docs) has no agreed date

evals.name: partner-business-review-eval-2-reads-well-too
evals.prompt: run partner-business-review on a transcript of a call that clearly covered every dimension well
evals.expected_output: The audit does not come back mostly Missed. The reads-well-too test from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized.
expectations: A genuinely strong call is not scored as mostly Missed
The reads-well-too test from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized
